name: std-learn-sandbox
description: Generic toggle-a-system→consequence instrument — a config-declared roster of elements (each with a weight and a default enabled state) sits on a biology-canvas connected by config-declared links; each element has a toggle button, and toggling recomputes a derived total (the summed weight of enabled elements) against a config-declared threshold, with a readout stating whether the system currently holds. Links to or from a disabled element render dimmed. Reset restores every element to its config-declared default. Element and link vocabulary is entirely config-declared, so the same mechanism serves any threshold-system exploration (coalition building, load balancing, ecosystem tipping points, circuit continuity) standalone. Standalone by default; behind a lab router set matchMode and it renders only when MODE_SELECTED matches.

elements.description: Roster of toggleable elements; each carries its label, its weight toward the derived total, its default enabled state, and its canvas position.
elements.label: Elements
elements.synonyms: element, node, component, module, factor, contributor

interactive.description: Enable pointer interaction on the canvas.
interactive.label: Interactive

links.description: Declared relationships drawn between elements; a link dims when either endpoint is disabled.
links.label: Links

matchMode.description: When composed behind a lab router, the MODE_SELECTED mode value this instrument responds to. Empty string means standalone — render immediately on INIT.
matchMode.label: Match Mode

outcomeLabel.description: Label prefix used in the readout describing the derived total and hold status.
outcomeLabel.label: Outcome Label

threshold.description: The summed weight of enabled elements must reach this value for the system to hold.
threshold.label: Threshold

emits.description: The system's derived total and hold status after each toggle — a composed listener (readout, grader) can subscribe; a harmless no-op when the atom runs standalone.
emits.synonyms: system update, total changed, threshold check, holds, tipping point

emits.description: Signals every element was restored to its config-declared default by Reset — a composed listener can subscribe; a harmless no-op when the atom runs standalone.

events.description: Lab router broadcast naming the active mode; this instrument renders when the mode equals matchMode, otherwise renders null.
events.name: Mode Selected

events.description: Learner toggled one element on or off, recomputing the derived total against the threshold.
events.name: Toggle

events.description: Learner restored every element to its config-declared default enabled state.
events.name: Reset

events.name: System Changed
